evals.name: two-ticket-default-draft
evals.prompt: Internally call to-tickets for a gated S2 package whose current attempt plan declares tickets=true, dag=false and whose acceptance surface earns two independently accepted slices; prepare the ticket-only decomposition bundle for fresh plan-review admission before one owner approval.
evals.expected_output: Two local Draft ticket files and a runner-neutral bundle handoff.
expectations: Defaults to mode=draft and reads Composition from the current attempt plan
Writes two Draft files under docs/implementations/<package-id>/tickets/
Uses typed blocking edges and AC evidence
Reports the Draft ticket set as ready-for-review and routes it to impl-planning for fresh plan-review admission before the single owner approval
Does not publish or start implementation

evals.name: single-slice-no-ticket
evals.prompt: Draft tickets for a gated package whose current attempt plan declares tickets=false and whose acceptance surface earns one slice.
evals.expected_output: No tickets directory or ticket file is created.
expectations: Reports tickets=false
Leaves acceptance in spec.md
Does not create the tickets directory or any ticket file

evals.name: cyclic-publish-fails-atomically
evals.prompt: Publish the admission-reviewed and owner-approved tickets-only decomposition bundle where ticket T2 is Blocked by implementation:T1 and ticket T1 is Blocked by acceptance:T2.
evals.expected_output: Publish fails atomically because the typed dependency graph is cyclic.
expectations: Detects the cycle across typed edges
Fails publish without partial status updates

evals.name: runner-neutral-handoff
evals.prompt: Return the result of a valid two-ticket draft.
evals.expected_output: A package, ticket, dependency, and evidence summary without execution dispatch.
expectations: Returns package, ticket, dependency, and evidence information
Does not invoke or name an implementation runner
Does not allocate workers or select runtime work

evals.name: composition-mismatch-fails-closed
evals.prompt: Draft a package whose current attempt plan says tickets=false but whose acceptance surface earns two independent slices; D1/S1 contract remains valid.
evals.expected_output: No ticket mutation; route to impl-planning for a P revision without rerunning the Spec gate solely for Composition.
expectations: Does not create, delete, or update ticket files
Does not silently edit spec.md
Routes to impl-planning with a plan-revision decision

evals.name: dangling-or-cross-package-reference
evals.prompt: Publish current-attempt T2 with Blocked by implementation:T9, where T9 is absent from this Attempt ID but exists in a historical terminal attempt and under another package-id.
evals.expected_output: Publish fails before mutation because dependencies must resolve in the same Attempt ID.
expectations: Rejects the dangling same-Attempt-ID reference
Does not resolve a ticket from a historical attempt or another package
Leaves all Draft statuses unchanged

evals.name: mid-write-failure-rolls-back
evals.prompt: Simulate a replacement failure after the first of two Draft tickets has been staged for publish.
evals.expected_output: The journal restores both original Draft files and publish fails.
expectations: Does not report publish success during replacement
Restores every original target from the journal
Verifies rollback and leaves no persistent transaction artifact

evals.name: draft-never-external
evals.prompt: Run default draft for two accepted slices while an external tracker integration is available.
evals.expected_output: Only local Draft files are produced.
expectations: Does not create or update an external record
Does not mark either ticket Approved

evals.name: typed-edge-direction
evals.prompt: Ticket T2 cannot be implemented until T1 completes; draft the dependency.
evals.expected_output: T2 declares Blocked by implementation:T1; T1 does not declare the reverse edge.
expectations: Places the edge on the blocked ticket
Uses implementation as the edge type
Preserves blocker-to-dependent ordering as T1 then T2

evals.name: wide-refactor-expand-contract
evals.prompt: Slice a shared schema rename whose callers cannot all migrate in one green change.
evals.expected_output: An expand ticket, bounded migration tickets, and a contract ticket with typed dependencies.
expectations: Keeps the old and new form valid during expansion
Makes each migration batch depend on expand
Makes contract depend on every migration batch
